notes:
v1.2.2 — one conversation per contact, faster photo loading, default favicon

- A customer's chat no longer splits into two threads: messages your bot or
  team send by phone number (order confirmations, handover alerts, reminders)
  now appear in the same conversation as the customer's replies. Existing
  duplicate threads are merged automatically on update, and the duplicate
  contact stops counting against your plan.
- Opening a chat with many photos no longer hits the rate limit, so images
  load instead of showing a "Photo" placeholder.
- Pages show a default icon in the browser tab unt
